title: Cultural Divergence Preservation: Diagnosing Flattening and Caricature in LLM-Simulated Survey Populations
reasoning: The paper leverages the World Values Survey (WVS) to measure cross-cultural divergence in synthetic LLM survey populations. The items evaluated include questions such as the 'Justifiability of Abortion' and 'Respect for Authority,' which directly assess moral judgments, value systems, and societal ethics across different cultural groups.
